questions: Should the function consider only the first occurrence of each distinct word for counting, or count all occurrences? The prompt says 'considering only their first occurrence' but the reference solution counts all occurrences.

Should the output Series have words as index and counts as values, sorted in any particular order (e.g., descending frequency, alphabetical)?
Is the stopwords list fixed as given, or should the function allow it to be modified (e.g., parameter or global variable)?
